search_text: published ZDI-23-1026 ZDI-CAN-20509 (Pwn2Own) Triangle MicroWorks SCADA Data Gateway Use of Hard-coded Credentials Authentication Bypass Vulnerability 2023-08-04 CVE-2023-39458 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-39458 5.3 AV:A/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['Triangle MicroWorks'] ['SCADA Data Gateway'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Triangle MicroWorks SCADA Data Gateway. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of certificates. The service uses a hard-coded default SSL certificate. title: (Pwn2Own) Triangle MicroWorks SCADA Data Gateway Use of Hard-coded Credentials Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Triangle MicroWorks SCADA Data Gateway.
